kiosk.description: Enable kiosk mode where the application is locked in operate mode.

operate.description: Start the application in Operate mode.

closebutton.description: Position for close button in virtual console: x,y,w,h. Only effective in kiosk mode.

web_port.description: Port number for remote web access.

locale.description: Locale for translation. Supported: ca_ES, cz_CZ, de_DE, en_GB, es_ES, fi_FI, fr_FR, it_IT, ja_JP, nl_NL, pt_BR.

debug_level.description: Debug output level (0-3). Note that level 0 is not included in released binaries.

workspace_file.description: Path to a .qxw workspace file to open on startup.
